title: Monochrome advertising formats

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Test a system without color because structure must also function in constrained reproduction.
strategic_value: Bold rules and condensed headings can preserve recognition in monochrome advertisements.
demonstration: Five black-and-white layouts range from tall strips to broader posters, including Road Show, Taking Over and Hair.
practical_value: Compare the role of frames and type when color is unavailable.

content_islands.name: Format row
content_islands.spec: Align five differently proportioned advertisements across the image.

content_islands.name: Internal hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Retain dominant show names, angled image-text units and small institutional signatures.

reference_purposes.Expression: Five black-and-white layouts range from tall strips to broader posters, including Road Show, Taking Over and Hair.
reference_purposes.Application: Five monochrome advertisements apply the identity to narrow strips and wider poster formats.
